findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_italian_pa · Private data: verify_italian_counterparty · Public sink: lookup_italian_pa · Destructive: check_partita_iva_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_italian_pa · Private data: verify_italian_counterparty · Public sink: lookup_italian_pa · Destructive: check_partita_iva_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_italian_pa" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
